description: The autonomy.grant refusal for an unknown subject (S56 T6, the -31833 family): the subject names an action that is not in the closed registry. The registry is closed (D14) — a grant for a name nobody compiled is a permission nobody granted, so the answer is a typed refusal with the pure validator's sentence verbatim in `what`, not a parse error and not a silent no-op. The three-part data keeps its generic halves; only `what` carries the refusal's own words.

data.what: forge.deploy is not a registry action (the registry is closed)
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
